title: AFC Champions League Elite opens with mixed fortunes for UAE's Shabab Al Ahli and Al Wasl
summary: The AFC Champions League Elite league phase began on Monday with mixed results for the UAE clubs. Shabab Al Ahli took all three points with a 1-0 home win over Iran's Tractor, settled by Yuri Cesar's opportunistic 22nd-minute strike at the Rashid Stadium. Al Wasl fell 2-1 away to Saudi debutants Al Qadsiah, conceding goals to Mexican forward Julian Quinones and Mateo Retegui after the 57th minute. Elsewhere Al Ittihad needed a 94th-minute Georginio Wijnaldum equaliser to rescue a point at Al Shamal.
